font_notes: Original Latin/math embedded programs and source style choices are retained. The Latin source fonts lack Korean; Korean text uses Noto Sans KR companions with matching weight, size and italic role (synthetic 12-degree Korean oblique where required).

The source Helvetica is unembedded Base14. Its translated Latin headers/footers use the exact Nimbus Sans Regular CFF program MuPDF uses for that source Helvetica. This is an explicit Base14 substitution, not a recovered organizer font file.

Flattened periodic-table/figure labels do not expose their original font files. Korean label faces/sizes are optical matches within the original label regions, not a claim of recovering those unknown source font files.
Historical element symbols/names Uut/Uup/Uus/Uuo, graph values/units, scientific taxon identifiers and image credits are retained from the original.
